newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-GMexico downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-GMexico downgraded to hold.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Serfin said on Wednesday it downgraded mining company Grupo Mexico to a hold rating from speculative buy.
"A strong price performance combined with an unfavorable outlook for copper prices have led us to lower our recommendation on the stock," analyst Hector Novoa wrote in a report.
He said the brokerage still sees a positive outlook for the company because of improving margins and lower costs in the second quarter.
Grupo Mexico's shares stood at 29.80 pesos at midday, down 40 centavos from Tuesday's close.
